subtitle: Hall of Fame former player analyzes the future of both teams in their next matchup

author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the night of September 13, the Cowboys will face the Giants at MetLife Stadium. Hall of Fame former wide receiver Michael Irvin, who has spoken in recent interviews, highlights that the New York team will change drastically before the end of the year, thanks to John Harbaugh's system. He states that, by the end of the year, the New York team will be "vastly different" from the one faced at the beginning of the season, with adjusted mentality and talent.

Irvin predicts Cowboys win in first meeting

In an interview with The Rich Eisen Show, Irvin predicted that the Dallas Cowboys will win the game against the Giants, as has happened in 16 of the last 18 matchups. However, he adds that the change in Harbaugh's scheme could alter the outcome.

Cowboys defense gains focus in 2026

Irvin also highlighted the changes in the Cowboys' defense, which was the weak point last season. He cited the trade for Micah Parsons, the arrival of Quinnen Williams, Rashan Gary, and Von Miller, as well as the signing of Caleb Downs in the secondary. He believes these pieces can transform the defensive unit, which in the previous season allowed 511 points.

Impact on the Super Bowl race

According to Irvin, the new defense could be the key to ending the franchise's 30-year Super Bowl drought, having not won since the 1990s. He states that the team cannot remain in the same cycle and that younger fans need to see the team in a final.

John Harbaugh's expectations for the Giants

Irvin believes Harbaugh's approach will change the New York team before the end of the year. He describes that the team will have adjusted talent and mentality, making the next matchup more challenging for the Cowboys.

Conclusion

The 2026 meeting between the Cowboys and the Giants draws attention because of the Cowboys' defensive changes and the expectation that the New York team will evolve rapidly. Michael Irvin, with his experience, offers an analysis that can influence fans' perception of the future of both teams.
